name: Click Before Frames
description: iOS input-buffer stage slider prototype. Selects and logs the delay stage; input interception remains disabled until the engine rebuild is ready.

tick-rate-stage.name: Tick rate
tick-rate-stage.description: Select the input-buffer delay stage: 2/2 → 4/4 → 8/8 → 16/8 → OFF. Four ticks = one frame at 60 FPS. This chooses the delay window, not Geometry Dash's native physics TPS.
